incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1792460000 \u2014 prod-inference \u2014 sudden surge in 5xxs + request drops on long-context endpoints since 11:22 UTC. p95 ~1.4s, error-rate 18%. paging @maria (oncall) and #eng-runtime.

maria (oncall): ack. looking at traces and log pipeline. grabbing runtime and shipper metrics.

maria (oncall): quick snapshot: many requests stalled at the log-shipper backpressure buffer, followed by upstream 503s from the proxy. runtime logs show repeated write timeouts to disk on pod worker-21.

jin: joining. can you paste the tail?

maria (oncall): ```
2026-03-17T11:22:07Z inference-runtime WARN worker-21 write to /var/log/inference/trace.log timed out (5s)
2026-03-17T11:22:08Z proxy ERROR upstream 503 "service unavailable" request_id=ff6a4b
2026-03-17T11:22:10Z autoscaler INFO scale-up detected but delayed due to image-pull backlog
```

sam: sounds like two compounding issues: disk write/backpressure in logging pipeline + slow autoscale. mitigations: 1) disable synchronous logging to disk for hot pods, 2) enable fallback routing to lower-memory model variant, 3) temporarily throttle long-context requests at the gateway.

maria (oncall): applying gateway throttle for requests with seq_len>8192, canary 25%.

maria (oncall): ```
POST /admin/gateway/throttle
{ "condition": "seq_len>8192", "action": "throttle", "max_qps": 5, "canary_pct": 25 }
```

deploy-bot: gateway throttle applied (gwn-20260317-04). canary live. monitoring.

jin: enabling fallback policy now: route heavy requests to rwd-large-lite when error_rate>0.07 for 45s.

jin: ```
POST /admin/fallbacks
{"trigger":{"metric":"error_rate","threshold":0.07,"window_s":45},"primary":"rwd-xxl","fallback":"rwd-large-lite"}
```

ops-bot: scheduled rolling restart for pods with write-timeout flag (worker-21..worker-24), stagger 30s starting 11:35 UTC.

maria (oncall): customers impacted: corp-mariner, cust-snow, platform-beta. CSMs notified for corp-mariner (high). mikayla not in channel so pinging via DM.

asha (sec): security request  please preserve full request traces for the incident window (11:1511:40 UTC) for SOC2. Do NOT rotate or compact the evidence bucket. Also need KMS key-use logs and the object ACL snapshot.

rahul: pulling audit + KMS logs now. heads-up: we had a partial log-shipper agent rollout last Thursday; there may be ingestion gaps on nodes that took the new agent. I'll map nodes to pod IPs and check for missing segments.

maria (oncall): rahul, raise as security follow-up if any gaps. owner=@rahul, deliverable: reconciled evidence bundle (journald, kubelet logs, pcap snippets, and KMS key-use CSV) + manifest sha256 by EOD 2026-03-17 23:59 UTC.

leo (audit): from compliance/audit perspective we need a chain-of-custody manifest: who exported, what time, destination bucket, and SHA256 of each object. mark access control lists and KMS decrypt events.

rahul: noted. initial scan shows two nodes with missing shipper entries: node-42 and node-43 between 2026-03-17T11:20:12Z and 11:26:30Z. I'll attach alternate sources (journald + tcpdump) and flag as evidence-gap.

jin: rolling restart started for flagged pods. also toggling async logging on hot pods to reduce disk pressure. command:

```bash
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime LOG_MODE=async -n prod --selector=hot=true
```

sam: autoscaler note  there was a backlog on image pulls in us-west-2 causing slow node provisioning. immediate action: bump pre-warmed node pool by +2 and increase node-provision timeout. owner=@sam, done as temporary measure.

maria (oncall): fallback routed ~20% of traffic by 11:38 UTC. error-rate down to 5.1% and p95 down to 760ms.

asha (sec): security follow-ups to include in postmortem: 1) audit-log ingestion gaps + remit, 2) preservation policy for evidence artifacts, 3) KMS access verification, 4) signed-manifest requirement for exported evidence.

rahul: will produce: tarball of journald for node-42/43, pcap snippets for 11:18-11:28 UTC, kubelet logs, S3 object manifest, and KMS key-use CSV. will include SHA256 manifest and ACLs.

maria (oncall): scheduling postmortem: propose 2026-03-20 14:00 UTC. include eng-runtime, eng-sre, security, platform infra, and compliance/audit. please confirm.

jin: that works for me. I'll prepare a reproduce plan (long-context load + shipper stress) and a short-term patch to prevent synchronous logs during peak load. owner=@jin, proposed due=2026-03-24.

sam: I'll open JIRA epic INF-2026-050 to track engineering and security remediation: autoscaler pre-warm (owner=sam, due=2026-03-19), logging-shipper rollback/guardrails (owner=jin, due=2026-03-22), per-tenant throttles (owner=sam+gateway, due=2026-03-25), postmortem doc (owner=maria, due=2026-03-19).

maria (oncall): handing monitoring to @sam for the night. current: error-rate 3.6%, fallback active as precaution, restarts in progress.

sam: taking handoff. I'll mute P3 alerts and will escalate if error-rate >5% or p95 >1.0s. keeping an eye on evidence exports to ensure immutability.

deploy-bot: config change applied: LOG_MODE=async on 60% of hot pods; fallback policy active.

incident-bot: incident 1792460000 updated: severity -> partial-outage, timeline recorded, postmortem scheduled 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z, incident owner=maria.

maria (oncall): thanks all. follow-ups assigned and evidence preservation confirmed. :white_check_mark:
